name: MD-15C medical droid
description: The MD-15C medical droid was a model of MD-series medical droid with a humanoid body shape and white plating. Their two arms had modular appendage sockets at the elbow joint and their featureless faces were designed to be non-threatening. A newer model than the 2-1B surgical droid, it had a vastly larger database that allowed it to treat thousands of additional species.
